props.title: The floor is yours.
props.text: DIADEM is our school’s Model UN society and debate union under one roof. Learn to argue, negotiate, draft and persuade, then take it to the circuit.

props.title: One union. Two ways to win the room.
props.intro: Some people want to spend three days building a coalition around a single operative clause. Others want to take apart a motion in seven minutes. DIADEM is for both.

items.title: Train
items.body: Workshops on research, speech structure, rebuttal, position papers and resolution writing.

items.title: Compete
items.body: In-house mock committees and debates first, then inter-school conferences and tournaments.

items.title: Lead
items.body: Chair committees, adjudicate rounds, and help organise DIADEM’s own events.

items.title: MUNSoc
items.body: Diplomacy, one clause at a time. Model United Nations: General Assembly committees, Crisis committees and position papers. GSL speeches, caucusing, resolution drafting, voting procedure.

items.title: Debate Union
items.body: Clash of ideas, on the clock. Competitive parliamentary debating: British Parliamentary, Asian Parliamentary and World Schools. Case building, rebuttal, Points of Information, adjudication.
